title: airy norwegian halibut salad
description: a light and refreshing norwegian-inspired salad featuring halibut, kimchi and peanut oil, perfect for a date night dinner
instructions: start by preparing the kimchi, peel and slice 1/2 cup of cucumber, and place it in a bowl with 2 tbsp of kimchi and 1 tbsp of soy sauce. refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
cut the halibut fillets into 1-inch pieces and place them on a plate. drizzle with 1 tbsp of peanut oil and season with salt and pepper.
heat 1-2 tbsp of peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. add the halibut and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
remove the halibut from the skillet and set it aside to rest. add the remaining 1/4 cup of peanut oil to the skillet and stir in 2 tbsp of kimchi and 1 tbsp of pickled red onion.
add the chopped cilantro and toasted sesame seeds to the skillet and stir to combine. season with salt and pepper to taste.
to assemble the salad, place the halibut on a plate and top with the kimchi-sesame seed mixture. drizzle with lemon juice and honey to taste.
garnish with additional cilantro and sesame seeds if desired.
